title: Antibiotic Prophylaxis in Transurethral Prostate Resection (TURP) and Transurethral Bladder Tumour Resection (TURB)
brief_summary: To investigate the use of antibiotic prophylaxis in patients undergoing TURP and TURB. The investigators set up a prospective, randomized controlled trial in which (after exclusion of risk factors) patients will be randomized in receiving levofloxacin (Tavanic) orally or no antibiotics. The exclusion criteria for TURP are a pre-operative transurethral catheter or \> 100 urinary white blood cells in the pre-operative urine sample. The exclusion criteria for TURB are a pre-op catheter or clinical signs of infection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* TURP or TURB.

Exclusion Criteria:

* TURP: pre-operative catheter/DJ/nephrostomy or \> 100 white blood cells in the pre- operative urinary sample.

TURB: pre-operative catheter/DJ/nephrostomy or clinical signs of infection (fever, myctalgia).
